## Summary

AI/ML engineer with three internships shipping LLM systems (local-LLM claims adjudication, enterprise RAG, production APIs). Builds agentic and RAG systems with measured evaluation, deterministic guardrails and human-in-the-loop safety.

## Professional experience

### AI Engineering Intern — Niva Bupa Health Insurance (May 2026 – Jul 2026)

- Built a claims auto-adjudication engine for the ReAssure 3.0 health policy: a 7-gate pipeline (policy, member, coverage, waiting period, exclusion, financial, state update) mixing deterministic rules with a local Gemma LLM on llama.cpp.
- Forced schema-valid JSON output with GBNF grammar-constrained decoding and built 4-tier confidence routing that sends uncertain claims to operations, clinical or senior-auditor review queues instead of forcing an automated verdict.
- Built a DAG rule planner (Kahn's topological sort) for audit-replayable plans, async FastAPI with per-gate SSE streaming, OCR + LLM extraction from discharge summaries, and a 67-test pytest suite that runs without a live LLM.

### Backend Engineering Intern — TechLearn (Feb 2026 – May 2026)

- Shipped the Dashboard Stats API serving real-time KPIs to educators, now the primary analytics endpoint in production.
- Replaced offset pagination with cursor-based pagination on submission retrieval, removing deep-page scan cost; added composite indexes and restructured trend queries to cut redundant aggregation passes.

### AI Development Intern — Path Infotech (Jun 2025 – Aug 2025)

- Deployed an enterprise RAG assistant on company servers for internal knowledge retrieval, building the semantic search pipeline with custom Azure Cognitive Search indexing skillsets for PDFs.
- Built a citation layer backed by MySQL tagging so every generated answer rendered clickable source references, making outputs auditable for non-technical staff.

## Projects

### IntelliOps: Agentic AIOps Platform — Deloitte Capstone Programme 2026

Repository: https://github.com/CodexManvik/intelliops

- Built a 7-service, event-driven AIOps platform (Python, FastAPI, Redis Streams, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, React) that collapses alert storms into incidents, ranks root causes and runs governed, reversible remediation on Kubernetes.
- On a live cluster: 75% alert-noise reduction, 41 s median time-to-fix, 21/30 fixes verified healthy with automatic rollback on failure; autonomy rose from 0% to 76.7% of runs as playbooks earned it from verified outcomes. 833 automated tests.
- Designed robust anomaly detection (median/MAD z-scores per metric and hour-of-day, persistence-gated) and confined the LLM agent to a closed 7-verb action vocabulary behind a synchronous, fail-closed human-approval gate with a full audit trail.

### DWT-CNN Invisible Image Watermarking — TensorFlow

Repository: https://github.com/CodexManvik/Deep-Learning-Based-Watermarking

- First-authored an end-to-end differentiable encode-attack-decode CNN embedding a 256-bit payload in the Haar DWT LL subband; 4.1M parameters, ~18 ms inference per image on an RTX 3050. Manuscript in preparation.
- Made JPEG differentiable (straight-through DCT quantization) in a 6-attack simulator; trained on 50K mixed-domain images to 37.3 dB PSNR, 0.97 SSIM, 3.2% BER, with 2.4–7x lower BER than a classical DWT baseline.

### Agentic RAG for Distributed Content — LangGraph

Repository: https://github.com/CodexManvik/Agentic-Rag-for-Distributed-Content

- Built a multi-agent LangGraph pipeline (plan, retrieve, adequacy check, reformulate, synthesize, citation validation) over hybrid vector + BM25 retrieval, abstaining instead of hallucinating when evidence is weak or a query is out of policy.
- Wrote an evaluation harness (Hit@k, MRR, citation precision, abstain precision/recall); tuned profile reached 0.690 Hit@k and 0.549 MRR at 28.8 s median latency on local models and blocked all prompt-injection test queries.

### Aethel: Local-First AI Agent Runtime — llama.cpp, FastAPI, Tauri, LanceDB (in development)

Repository: https://github.com/CodexManvik/Aethel

- Local desktop agent with permissioned, rollback-safe tools; Reflective Skill Memory keeps or retires skills by success rate.

### Other projects

- FloatChat-AI (https://github.com/CodexManvik/FloatChat-AI): NL-to-SQL and semantic search over ARGO ocean data; Smart India Hackathon 2025 national semi-finalist.
- Interview Mirror (https://github.com/CodexManvik/Interview-Mirror): real-time AI interview coach with MediaPipe landmark tracking, Gemini, Whisper and TTS.
- MusicGen (https://github.com/CodexManvik/automatic-music-generation): transformer and LSTM-based MIDI music generation.
